description: Captages d'eau is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Captages d'eau autorisés privé Recensement des captages d'eau superficielle ou d'eau souterraine à usage privé qui ont fait l'objet d'un arrêté d'autorisation de prélèvement d'eau. La précision des coordonnées des captages dépend de leur méthode d'obtention. Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Environment, Climate. Its keywords are eaux, hydrologies, hydro, hydrauliques, souterrains, superficielles. The portal shows 2024-04-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
